original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹湖泊州伦拜克北部冲突致三人死亡后禁止本地酿酒
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹湖泊州伦拜克北部县当局在Pan Adieng与Payueth两个亚部族冲突造成三人死亡、两人受伤后，禁止酿造和销售本地生产的酒精饮料。代理县长称，周二下午5时左右在Malueth Payam总部爆发暴力事件，当时正在举行和平对话，受酒精影响的武装青年卷入冲突。当局要求地方首领在七天内查明并移交责任人，并指示逮捕酿酒或持有酿酒原料者，违者拘留三个月。

location.raw_text: Rumbek North County in Lakes State, Malueth Payam headquarters

key_facts.fact: 伦拜克北部县两个亚部族冲突造成三人死亡、两人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: clashes between members of the Pan Adieng and Payueth sub-clans left three people dead and two wounded

key_facts.fact: 当局禁止酿造和销售本地生产的酒精饮料
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Authorities in Rumbek North County in Lakes State have banned the brewing and sale of locally produced alcohol

key_facts.fact: 暴力事件于周二下午5时左右在Malueth Payam总部爆发
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The violence broke out at about 5 p.m. on Tuesday at the Malueth Payam headquarters

key_facts.fact: 代理县长要求地方首领在七天内查明并移交责任人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: he had given local chiefs seven days to identify and hand over those responsible for investigation

key_facts.fact: 酿酒或持有酿酒原料者将面临三个月拘留
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: with offenders facing three months in detention

uncertainties: 事件细节目前仅来自单一来源Radio Tamazuj，尚缺乏交叉验证
代理县长将暴力归因于本地酿酒，该因果判断尚未获独立证实
